title: Installation Profile — v1
description: The venue document (C1, ratified 2026-08-22; design: docs/plans/2026-07-09-phase3-1-installation-profile.md §1). It records what is installed for one event and binds the pack's abstract names to physical things. It is engine-side config, never pack content, homed here per owner answer OQ6 (slice 4). profileService loads one profile frozen at boot, through the PROFILE_PATH seam. The v1 engine reads kind, schemaVersion, profileId, forPack, bindings.lighting, and bindings.surfaces (slice 6); nothing else. The other sections are the ratified C1 shape. They are typed to catch authoring typos, and C2/C3 (resolution, preflight) consume them as they build. Open interiors (endpoints) get pinned by the slice that consumes them. Venue details never enter the pack. Pack content never names venue instruments.

forPack.description: Optional pack pin; tooling warns on mismatch, never refuses.

network.description: Network posture (2026-07-09 decision). kit-network is standard: the kit carries its own router, the orchestrator Pi has a reserved IP and answers the public DNS name on the LAN. venue-wifi is the fallback; its dynamic-DNS fields arrive with the Track-E E2 build (schema evolution).

orchestrator.description: The stack is ONE switch (kit-model decision). true: every stack service is expected live, and a missing one is a FAULT. false: the minimum install tier (player scanners and tokens only) — no orchestrator features.

endpoints.description: What equipment is installed tonight. An absent endpoint makes its features DORMANT by configuration, never an error (C2/C3 semantics). The interior shape stays open in v1; C2 pins it when resolution becomes the consumer.

bindings.description: Pack abstract names → venue instruments/media. bindings.lighting (B8): lighting roles → HA scenes (v1 drives the ha provider only; WLED and friends are schema-evolution headroom). bindings.surfaces (slice 6): display-surface channels → media files. Keys must be declared in the matching pack block (game.json lightingRoles / surfaces.idleLoop) — a tooling/preflight check, not expressible here.

ha.description: A concrete Home Assistant scene id, e.g. 'scene.police_1'. Concrete instrument names live HERE, never in pack cues.

surfaces.description: A3 slice 6: pack display-surface CHANNEL names (game.json surfaces.idleLoop) → concrete venue media files. Concrete filenames live HERE, never in pack content (media never lives in git packs, ROADMAP §2.3). v1 binds the idle-loop channel to a video file in the orchestrator's video dir.

file.description: A concrete media filename resolved against the orchestrator's video dir, e.g. 'idle-loop.mp4'.

audio.description: B7: venue audio config (routes + ducking stay venue, never pack).

env.description: The venue-owned slice of .env (network/infra keys only; game-scoped keys live in game.json per B11). null = use the engine default.
